lines.text: Sigh... getting down here was a nightmare.
All the snacks I had to hand out, all the drinks I had to pay for... I don't even want to think about the cost.
Still, it paid off. I got a lead on someone who'd just come up from below.
Playing the part of a die-hard V.T.C. follower worked like a charm.
I got close to him, got him drunk, and lifted an access pass right out of his pocket.
I'll write the rest once I'm further in.
I did it! I actually did it! This is it! A real scoop!
What they've got hidden underground is... a giant eyeball? No, some massive spherical machine.
And that's not all. This isn't some "space development project" like the government claims. There's something else going on down here.
If I can pull this off, everything I've been through will finally be worth it.
If I can just get my hands on the proposal for the Mechanical Messiah Proj
